name: WEFT_FINAL_BLIND_V2_2026_09_08

authorship.method: A clean-room agent authored cases from catalog and product-attribute files without inspecting search implementation or output; a separate clean-room verifier reviewed labels against catalog facts before sealing.
authorship.limitations: Labels are AI-assisted catalog judgements, not independent human relevance annotations or live-user interaction data.

protocol.resultCap: returned <= maxResults when maxResults is present
protocol.forbiddenRule: no forbiddenTop ID may appear in top forbiddenTopK
protocol.negativeRule: relevant is empty, maxResults is 0, and any exact match fails
protocol.alternativesRule: shopper-facing alternatives are excluded; only semanticSearch().matches is evaluated
protocol.hashCanonicalization: Text hashes normalize CRLF/CR to LF; catalog files are separated by a NUL byte before hashing.

policy: Freeze set, catalog, engine, evaluator, validator and loaders before the first run. Any failure-driven ranking change consumes the entire set and requires a new untouched blind generation.
